g.text: TRIMIX / TEST PADS AND BRING-UP ACCESS

g.desc: TRIMIX / TEST PADS AND BRING-UP ACCESS

g.text: Twelve bare 1.0 mm copper pads. Matching global labels connect to the existing circuit pages.

g.desc: Twelve bare 1.0 mm copper pads. Matching global labels connect to the existing circuit pages.

g.text: Pad locations, clearances and physical test access are verified on the PCB; this page adds no circuit bias or switches.

g.desc: Pad locations, clearances and physical test access are verified on the PCB; this page adds no circuit bias or switches.

g.text: Do not bridge adjacent pads. Keep the charge-arm shunt open during initial power checks.

g.desc: Do not bridge adjacent pads. Keep the charge-arm shunt open during initial power checks.

g.text: Use TP1001 as the circuit ground reference. HE_SENSE and O2_VMID require a high-impedance probe.

g.desc: Use TP1001 as the circuit ground reference. HE_SENSE and O2_VMID require a high-impedance probe.

g.text: Place pads where a probe can reach them after opening the rear cover. Label each pad on silkscreen.

g.desc: Place pads where a probe can reach them after opening the rear cover. Label each pad on silkscreen.
